description: Na₂Li₈U₁₁(WO₂₂)₂ crystallizes in the triclinic P̅1 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.46-2.98 Å. There are four inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids that share corners with two equivalent UO₆ octahedra, corners with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 45-49°. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.09-2.34 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted LiO₆ octahedra that share corners with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one UO₆ octahedra,  an edgeedge with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid, and edges with two equivalent LiO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.46 Å. In the third Li site, Li is bonded to five O atoms to form LiO₅ square pyramids that share corners with four UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, edges with two equivalent LiO₆ octahedra, and  an edgeedge with one LiO₅ square pyramid. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.03-2.20 Å. In the fourth Li site, Li is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Li-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.34 Å. There are six inequivalent U sites. In the first U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₆ octahedra, corners with two equivalent UO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ square pyramid, and edges with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 51-68°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.85-2.57 Å. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.89-2.37 Å. In the third U site, U is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.60 Å. In the fourth U site, U is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted UO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids, corners with two equivalent LiO₅ trigonal bipyramids,  an edgeedge with one LiO₆ octahedra, and edges with two UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.86-2.29 Å. In the fifth U site, U is bonded to seven O atoms to form distorted UO₇ pentagonal bipyramids that share  a cornercorner with one LiO₆ octahedra,  a cornercorner with one UO₇ pentagonal bipyramid,  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ square pyramid,  a cornercorner with one LiO₅ trigonal bipyramid, and  an edgeedge with one UO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 49°. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.36 Å. In the sixth U site, U is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to eight O atoms. There are a spread of U-O bond distances ranging from 1.87-2.71 Å. W is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.78-1.95 Å.
